description: This file defines functions and types for grouping and sharding test cases in a test runner, including logic for parallel execution, grouping by worker and require file, and shard filtering.

methods.name: createTestGroups
methods.description: Groups test cases into test groups based on worker hash, require file, parallel mode, and hooks, considering expected parallelism.

methods.name: filterForShard
methods.description: Filters test groups to include only those assigned to a specific shard, balancing based on weights.
